name: MTT Shipping and Logistics Berhad
overview: MTT Shipping and Logistics Berhad 于2026年完成首次公开募股并在 Bursa Malaysia 主板上市。年内公司未公告任何业务板块的扩张、缩减、出售或新合约，所公告事项主要为上市相关、公司秘书及地址变更、股息派发和 recurrent related party transactions。
overview_en: MTT Shipping and Logistics Berhad completed its initial public offering and listed on the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia in 2026. During the year, the company did not announce any expansion, reduction, disposal, or new contracts for its business segments; the announcements were mainly related to the listing, changes of company secretary and address, dividend payment, and recurrent related party transactions.
